name: ATHUL DEV
headline: AI & Backend Engineer | LLM Systems, Agentic Workflows & Full-Stack Python Delivery
summary: AI and Backend Engineer with one year of professional Software Engineering experience, building production LLM applications, agentic tool-calling systems, and scalable Python backends. Experienced across the full stack — from RAG pipelines and multi-provider LLM fallback infrastructure to async FastAPI services on PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Comfortable owning a system end-to-end: architecture, database design, API delivery, and reliability under real-world load and provider outages.

bullets: Architected production-grade FastAPI REST APIs for e-commerce inventory and order processing, supporting concurrent user sessions with async, non-blocking read/write database operations.
Built vector-based semantic search pipelines that cut manual data-retrieval effort for internal queries by replacing keyword lookup with embedding-based matching.
Improved system reliability under high-traffic load through async database architecture redesign and connection-level optimizations.

projects.name: DOOM — Autonomous AI Assistant
bullets: Architected a ReAct-style agent orchestrating 26 registered tools for job discovery, email, WhatsApp, contacts, RAG, and automation, under strict tool-calling protocols with hallucination guardrails.
Achieved zero-downtime AI availability via a 4-provider, 14-model fallback chain (Gemini → OpenAI → Groq → OpenRouter), cleanly handling rate limits and provider outages.
Built a ChromaDB + SentenceTransformers RAG pipeline with overlap-aware chunking and deduplication; automated job-discovery and lead enrichment across Naukri, LinkedIn, Snov.io, and Gmail API.

projects.name: Neolix — B2B Sales Outreach Automation
bullets: Built a 9-day, 3-channel (Email/WhatsApp/SMS) outreach cadence engine with AI copywriting via Groq Llama 3.3, dynamically routed by cost-latency tradeoff, plus Gmail API (OAuth 2.0) integration.

Cut median API latency 66% (2700ms → 920ms) by diagnosing connection-limit bottlenecks via Locust load testing and implementing asyncpg connection pooling; verified sub-millisecond GIN-indexed search over 1M+ profiles.
Resolved a cross-database bug where a query referenced a non-existent PostgreSQL table, replacing it with a correctly aligned MongoDB-backed lookup.

projects.name: Ekabhumi — End-to-End E-Commerce Platform
bullets: Designed a three-layer payment verification system (client HMAC-SHA256, server-side Razorpay cross-check, separately-keyed webhooks) with idempotent processing to prevent duplicate order fulfillment.
Built Google OAuth 2.0 authentication issuing self-signed JWTs with server-side role assignment and silent token refresh.

education.degree: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), University of Calicut — Computer Science
